title: Second round of Launch Pad selections includes eight newcomers
summary: The National Reactor Innovation Center at Idaho National Laboratory has announced 13 project selections across 12 companies for the Nuclear Energy Launch Pad, a Department of Energy–led program that integrates reactor and fuel facility authorization, testing, and deployment support for private nuclear developers. The Launch Pad emerged from the Reactor Pilot Program and Fuel Line Pilot Program. According to INL, projects selected include reactor development and nuclear fuel cycle advancements, including fabrication, enrichment, and conversion technologies.

title: NECX 2026 kicks off with a look to the future
summary: The second annual Nuclear Energy Conference & Expo (NECX 2026), hosted in Dallas, Texas, kicked off this morning with an exciting opening plenary that saw leaders from government, regulation, and industry discussing the unprecedented opportunities now open to the nuclear sector. NECX, the premier nuclear industry conference cohosted by the American Nuclear Society and the Nuclear Energy Institute, is all about leveraging those opportunities.

title: GAO report analyzes nuclear fuel efforts in national security and commercial sectors
summary: The Government Accountability Office has released a report to Congress titled “Nuclear Fuel: Actions Needed to Enhance Cost Reporting and Economic Analysis for Federal Uranium Supply Efforts.” The report describes National Nuclear Security Administration estimates of enriched uranium supplies and demands, examines the NNSA’s plans to meet enriched uranium needs, and describes potential challenges to meeting supply goals. It also examines Department of Energy efforts to support the front-end fuel cycle for the commercial nuclear industry.

title: Market monitor issues spring 2026 quarterly report
summary: The total estimated wholesale market cost of electricity was $1.75 billion, up 6% from spring 2025. The post Market monitor issues spring 2026 quarterly report appeared first on ISO Newswire.

title: Entergy Mississippi storm update — 8/24/2026, 3 p.m.
summary: Progress continued yesterday in the outage restoration from Thursday through Sunday morning weather impacts to the Entergy Mississippi service territory. In total, approximately 75,000 outages have occurred during these weather fronts with nearly 99% restored.
